fields.name: cpes
fields.short: A list of Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) identifiers that specify the affected product(s) or component(s) by this vulnerability.

fields.name: cve_id
fields.short: The unique identifier assigned to a reported vulnerability, adhering to the CVE-YYYY-NNNNN format, which helps in tracking and referencing vulnerabilities systematically.

fields.name: cvss
fields.short: The Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) score, newest version, which ranges from 0 to 10, quantifies the severity of the vulnerability based on various factors such as exploitability, impact, and ease of attack.

fields.name: cvss_v2
fields.short: The Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) score version 2, which ranges from 0 to 10, quantifies the severity of the vulnerability based on various factors such as exploitability, impact, and ease of attack.

fields.name: cvss_v3
fields.short: The Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) score version 3, which ranges from 0 to 10, quantifies the severity of the vulnerability based on various factors such as exploitability, impact, and ease of attack.

fields.name: cvss_v4
fields.short: The Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) score version 4, which ranges from 0 to 10, quantifies the severity of the vulnerability based on various factors such as exploitability, impact, and ease of attack.

fields.name: cvss_version
fields.short: The version of the CVSS used in the cvss field.

fields.name: epss
fields.short: The Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS) score, a probabilistic measure between 0 and 1 (0 and 100%)., predicts the likelihood of a vulnerability being exploited in the wild within the next 30 days.

fields.name: kev
fields.short: A boolean value indicating whether the vulnerability is known to be exploited in the wild, which is crucial for prioritizing patching and mitigation efforts.

fields.name: propose_action
fields.short: Suggested actions or mitigation strategies to address the vulnerability, aimed at reducing its impact or eliminating the risk to affected systems.

fields.name: published_time
fields.short: The date and time when the vulnerability was published, in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, with UTC time zone.

fields.name: ranking_epss
fields.short: This score ranks the vulnerability in terms of its EPSS score relative to all other scored vulnerabilities.

fields.name: ransomware_campaign
fields.short: Indicates if the vulnerability has been exploited in ransomware campaigns, highlighting its significance and potential impact on security posture.

fields.name: references
fields.short: A list of references providing further details, technical advisories, and mitigation guidance related to the vulnerability, facilitating deeper understanding and research.

fields.name: summary
fields.short: A brief overview of the vulnerability, providing essential information on what it entails, the affected systems, and the potential impact in clear, understandable English.
